statement:
The record for case RF-6120 lists a refund amount of USD 23,000.00 for a purchase where the total amount paid was only USD 230.00.

I am placing this refund on hold due to the extreme discrepancy between the amount paid ($230.00) and the recorded refund amount ($23,000.00), which appears to be a clerical error. The case should be reviewed and corrected before any funds are released.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the refund amount is a clerical error, "$23,000.00... appears to be a clerical error" versus the $230.00 paid, and refuses to release funds.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
